description: Agentic RL project-local triage rules. Keep queue broad but make card admission evidence-based and simple. Move data-mechanism papers to /Users/chy/Research/agent-data/.
hard_gates: Queue row is not a card.
Survey mention is recall evidence, not paper evidence.
No original paper PDF/HTML brief, no formal L1 card.
Survey-only formal cards are invalid legacy artifacts; move or mark them outside the formal notes set and do not count them as valid L1 cards.
Formal L1 cards in notes/ root must pass scripts/autoresearch.py validate before being reported as complete.
queue_policy: Queue is recall-oriented: if a seed survey discusses a method in the main text and it plausibly touches agentic RL, add it to queue.
A survey mention is a recall signal, not proof of importance.
Reference-only mentions do not enter queue unless another source discusses the method in main text.

Forward recall is required for active fast-moving tracks: when a carded anchor has obvious newer follow-ups or comparisons after the seed-survey cutoff, add those follow-ups to queue even if the seed surveys could not mention them.
card_admission_rules: Default direct card: seed-survey main-text mention + open-source code/environment + top venue or strong venue.
Strong venues currently include NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, TMLR, COLM, and comparable main-conference publications.
Workshop papers are not strong venue by themselves.
ArXiv exception: seed-survey main-text mention + official open-source code/environment + clear RL mechanism.
ArXiv exception also applies when the paper is discussed by two or more seed surveys, has a later strong-venue version, or is already a de facto baseline/environment used by later methods.
Post-survey exception: newer arXiv paper + official code + direct comparison against a carded anchor such as GRPO, GiGPO, RAGEN, WebRL, Search-R1, or ArCHer.
No code/no environment usually stays queue, unless the paper is a top-venue mechanism paper or repeatedly used as a baseline.
select_rules: Core contribution is reward design, policy optimization, RL objective, online exploration, credit assignment, rollout/replay, or environment interaction learning loop.
Directly changes tool-use/web/GUI/coding/embodied agent RL method or evaluation protocol.
Has official code/environment or is a strong-venue paper.
Could create novelty risk for an Agentic RL idea.

paper_type_taxonomy.core-rl-method: Changes RL mechanism directly: optimizer/objective, credit assignment, reward shaping, advantage estimation, exploration, rollout/replay.
paper_type_taxonomy.environment-recipe: Applies RL to a concrete agentic setting such as search, web, GUI, code, tool-use, or deep research; contribution is often environment workflow, reward recipe, or training recipe.
paper_type_taxonomy.infra-interface: Builds agent RL execution/training interface, tool integration, rollout system, or observability/disaggregation infrastructure.
paper_type_taxonomy.benchmark-env: Provides environment, benchmark, verifier, or evaluation protocol; card only if it materially affects RL training/evaluation.
paper_type_taxonomy.data-overlap: Core object is data/trajectory/environment generation or curation; keep cross-link and consider /Users/chy/Research/agent-data/.

type_guidance: GiGPO, BEACON, CARL, HCAPO, SPA-RL, ArCHer, VinePPO, IGPO, AgentPRM, SWEET-RL are core-rl-method.
Search-R1, R1-Searcher, DeepResearcher, Atom-Searcher, WebRL, WebAgent-R1, DigiRL, SWE-RL, ToolRL are environment-recipe unless their main novelty is a reusable RL mechanism.
Agent Lightning, VerlTool, SWE-Gym, ToolGym, BrowserGym are infra-interface or benchmark-env depending on whether they train models or provide environments.
When unsure, assign paper_type by the reusable contribution, not by the application domain.
maybe_rules: Survey main-text mention, but venue or open-source status is missing.
Useful background for SFT warm start, environment scaling, benchmark protocol, or data/replay interface.
Mixed data/RL paper where RL contribution is plausible but not yet verified.
ArXiv paper with code but unclear whether the contribution is RL mechanism or mostly system/recipe.
ignore_rules: Prompt-only agent, benchmark-only paper, or generic agent framework with no RL update/reward/exploration mechanism.
ArXiv paper with no code/environment and no cross-survey discussion.
move_to_agent_data_rules: Core contribution is training data generation, filtering, verification, repair, reweighting, curriculum, or failure trajectory mining.
RL is only the downstream consumer of the proposed data pipeline.
